page_topic_one_liner: AI language learning tools — three tiers: gamification-first (Duolingo), speaking-first conversation (Speak), and phoneme-level accent coaching (BoldVoice)
differentiator_vs_generic: This is speaking-first vs gamified streak learning split with pronunciation feedback — NOT generic globe/flags, NOT homework helper. Hero must contrast voice waveform speaking practice against gamified streak/leaderboard UI in a split composition.
visual_anchors: HERO (~55% canvas): Split comparison — left half: gamified streak flame + leaderboard bar (Duolingo-tier metaphor), right half: live voice waveform + microphone with speaking practice bubbles (Speak-tier), alignify-navy divider line between halves
Secondary: phoneme pronunciation feedback — mouth/phoneme diagram with green/red accent markers on /θ/ vs /s/ sounds
Tertiary: three-tier label strip — gamified platform / speaking-first / accent coach icons in a row (depth not breadth)
anti_patterns: Generic world globe with flags as hero
LLM chat translation panel as hero
Single-tier app screenshot without comparison split
Textbook grammar page as primary visual
